description:
## What

Multipurpose-generation sibling to `SmimeSponsorValidated` (Sponsor
Strict, shipped via PKIX-jbvb.7). Per CA/B Forum S/MIME BR §7.1.6.1:
Multipurpose certs assert policy OID `2.23.140.1.5.3.2` and permit
additional EKU values beyond `emailProtection` (document-signing
crossover use cases).

Not blocked — Sponsor Strict is shipped. Structural template is in
`pkix-profiles-cabf/src/lib.rs` `SmimeSponsorValidated`.

## API shape

```rust
pub struct SmimeSponsorValidatedMultipurpose;

impl Profile for SmimeSponsorValidatedMultipurpose {
    fn id(&self) -> &'static str { "cabf.smime.sponsor.multipurpose" }
    fn version(&self) -> &'static str { "1.0.14" }
    fn policy(&self, now_unix: u64) -> ValidationPolicy {
        // Baseline same as SmimeSponsorValidated (Strict), with:
        // - required_leaf_policy_oids: [2.23.140.1.5.3.2]
        // - EKU permissiveness per §7.1.2.3(f) Multipurpose row
        // - same DN rule: organizationName ∧ organizationIdentifier ∧
        //   ((givenName ∧ surname) ∨ pseudonym) per §7.1.4.2.5 Note 2
    }
}

pub const fn smime_sponsor_multipurpose_policy(now_unix: u64) -> ValidationPolicy { ... }
```

## Subject DN rule

Per §7.1.4.2.5 Multipurpose column: identical to Strict (same SHALL
attrs, same Note 2 covering both Multipurpose and Strict). Reuse the
exact same `DnAttrRule` construction as `SmimeSponsorValidated`.

## OID constant

Add `CABF_SMIME_SPONSOR_VALIDATED_MULTIPURPOSE_POLICY` =
`ObjectIdentifier::new_unwrap("2.23.140.1.5.3.2")`.

## Test fixture

Generate `smime-sponsor-multipurpose-self-signed-365d.der` and
`smime-sponsor-multipurpose-pseudonym-self-signed-365d.der` (matching
the two-form pattern used for Sponsor Strict). Extension to
`gen-smime-tier-fixtures.py` — Sponsor Multipurpose form is identical
to Sponsor Strict except for the policy OID.

## Acceptance

- Type, alias, OID constant ship.
- 2 positive fixtures (givenName+surname form, pseudonym form).
- Negative: Sponsor Strict cert fails this profile by OID mismatch; this
  profile's cert fails Sponsor Strict by OID mismatch.
- CHANGELOG + divergences.md updated.
- Same clippy/fmt/test bars as PKIX-jbvb.9.2.

## Not blocked

Sponsor Strict (PKIX-jbvb.7) is shipped. This bead can be claimed by
the autonomous loop as soon as the epic priority surfaces it.
